import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Subgroup Set Polynomial Ideal
open scoped BigOperators

theorem bounded_normal_sylow {G : Type*} [Group G] [Fintype G]
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hp_bound : 25 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ 100)
    (hG : Nat.card G = 24 * p) :
    ∃ P : Sylow p G, p ∣ Nat.card G ∧ P.Normal := by
  classical
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty (Sylow p G))
  
  set n : ℕ := Nat.card (Sylow p G) with hn
  
  have hmod : n ≡ 1 [MOD p] := by
    simpa [n] using card_sylow_modEq_one p G
  
  have hdiv_index : n ∣ P.index := by
    simpa [n] using (Sylow.card_dvd_index (p := p) (G := G) P)
  
  have hindex_dvd : P.index ∣ Nat.card G := by
    simpa [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using P.1.index_dvd_card
  
  have hdiv_card : n ∣ Nat.card G :=
    Nat.dvd_trans hdiv_index hindex_dvd
  
  have hdiv_mul : n ∣ p * 24 := by
    rw [hG] at hdiv_card
    simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using hdiv_card
  
  have hnotdiv : ¬p ∣ n := by
    simpa [n] using not_dvd_card_sylow p G
  
  have hcoprime : Nat.Coprime n p := by
    simpa [Nat.coprime_comm] using (hp.coprime_iff_not_dvd).2 hnotdiv
  
  have hdiv24 : n ∣ 24 :=
    hcoprime.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left hdiv_mul
  
  have hpos : 0 < n := by
    simpa [n] using (Nat.card_pos : 0 < Nat.card (Sylow p G))
  
  have hn_le : n ≤ 24 :=
    Nat.le_of_dvd (by decide) hdiv24
  
  have hn_lt_p : n < p := by
    omega
  
  have hmod_eq : n % p = 1 % p := by
    simpa [Nat.ModEq] using hmod
  
  have hn_eq_one : n = 1 := by
    have hn_mod : n % p = n :=
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hn_lt_p
    have hone_mod : 1 % p = 1 :=
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
    omega
  
  have hsub : Subsingleton (Sylow p G) := by
    exact
      (Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.mp
        (by simpa [n] using hn_eq_one)).1
  
  have hnormal : P.Normal := by
    letI : Subsingleton (Sylow p G) := hsub
    exact Sylow.normal_of_subsingleton P
  
  refine ⟨P, ?_, hnormal⟩
  rw [hG]
  exact ⟨24, by simp [Nat.mul_comm]⟩

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Subgroup Set Polynomial Ideal
open scoped BigOperators

theorem bounded_normal_sylow {G : Type*} [Group G] [Fintype G]
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hp_bound : 25 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ 100)
    (hG : Nat.card G = 24 * p) :
    ∃ P : Sylow p G, p ∣ Nat.card G ∧ P.Normal := by
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  letI : Fintype (Sylow p G) := Fintype.ofFinite (Sylow p G)
  
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := Sylow.nonempty (p := p) (G := G)
  
  have hpG : p ∣ Nat.card G := by
    rw [hG]
    simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using (Nat.dvd_mul_right p 24)
  
  have hn_dvd : Nat.card (Sylow p G) ∣ Nat.card G := by
    exact Nat.dvd_trans P.card_dvd_index P.1.index_dvd_card
  
  have hp_not_n : ¬p ∣ Nat.card (Sylow p G) :=
    not_dvd_card_sylow p G
  
  have hcop : Nat.Coprime (Nat.card (Sylow p G)) p := by
    exact (hp.coprime_iff_not_dvd.mpr hp_not_n).symm
  
  have hn24 : Nat.card (Sylow p G) ∣ 24 := by
    have hn_dvd' := hn_dvd
    rw [hG] at hn_dvd'
    exact hcop.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right hn_dvd'
  
  have hn_le : Nat.card (Sylow p G) ≤ 24 :=
    Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num) hn24
  
  have hn_mod : Nat.card (Sylow p G) ≡ 1 [MOD p] :=
    card_sylow_modEq_one p G
  
  have hn_one : Nat.card (Sylow p G) = 1 := by
    apply hn_mod.eq_of_lt_of_lt
    · exact lt_of_le_of_lt hn_le hp_bound.1
    · omega
  
  have hcard : Fintype.card (Sylow p G) = 1 := by
    simpa using hn_one
  
  rcases Fintype.card_eq_one_iff.mp hcard with ⟨Q, hQ⟩
  
  letI : Subsingleton (Sylow p G) :=
    ⟨fun A B => (hQ A).trans (hQ B).symm⟩
  
  exact ⟨Q, hpG, Sylow.normal_of_subsingleton Q⟩
